source_text: Qui tantummodo credunt, nondum tamen oculos columbae habent, dicunt de Verbo: Vidimus eum, et non habebat speciem neque decorem. Qui vero proficit et oculos spiritales accepit, dicit: Ecce tu pulcher es. Fides sine contemplatione speciem abscondit; intelligentia spiritalis decorem revelat.
pass_a_gloss: Who only believe, not-yet however eyes of-dove have, say about Word: We-saw him, and not he-had appearance nor beauty...
pass_b_english: Those who only believe, and do not yet have dove-eyes, say of the Word: [[We saw him, and he had no form or comeliness >> Bible:Isaiah 53:2]]. But she who has progressed and received spiritual eyes says: Behold, you are fair. Faith without contemplation hides the form; spiritual understanding reveals the beauty.
